Ranked by the game's "sound rate" weight (higher = stronger bonus tier). Only the top 40 wings shown.

Methodology: Hero power = ATK + secondary ATK + DEF + HP (datamined base values). Tiers assigned as S = top 15%, A = next 25%, B = next 30%, C = bottom. This is not a substitute for community consensus — it's the objective starting point the site's meta tools build on.
